result.title: PVWander: 3D Memory-guided Panoramic Video Wandering with Path-Facing Canonicalization
result.summary: Long-horizon panoramic video wandering aims to continuously synthesize scene-consistent $360^\circ$ observations along user-specified camera trajectories from an initial equirectangular projection (ERP) panorama. Existing panoramic video models have achieved promising results in camera-controlled generation, while recent 3D-guided approaches further provide geometric guidance for improving scene consistency. However, stable long-horizon wandering remains challenging due to diverse motion--orientation relationships and imperfect memory guidance induced by accumulated generation artifacts and depth inaccuracies. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{PVWander}, a 3D-memory-guided framework that accumulates generated observations into an online point-cloud memory and reprojects it to guide subsequent generation, with two complementary designs: \textit{Path-Facing canonicalization} for motion--orientation alignment and \textit{Timestep-aware gating modulation} for adaptive memory guidance. \textit{Path-Facing canonicalization} exploits the horizontal cyclic symmetry of ERP panoramas to uniformly align each clip's ERP orientation with its principal translation direction, yielding more consistent, forward-like relative motions while preserving the prescribed camera path. \textit{Timestep-aware gating modulation} exploits the coarse-to-fine nature of diffusion denoising to adaptively regulate reprojected memory guidance through timestep-dependent channel-wise gates, preserving its structural benefits while mitigating visual artifacts from imperfect projections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PVWander achieves improved long-horizon generation quality, while ablations validate the effectiveness of both designs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PVWander，用于长时程全景视频漫游：将已生成的观测累积为在线点云记忆并重投影以引导后续生成，配合「Path-Facing 规范化」统一各片段的 ERP 朝向以实现运动—朝向对齐，并用时间步感知的门控调制自适应调节记忆引导强度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身是全景视频生成，但其对不完美重投影记忆按去噪阶段做通道级门控的思路，可能与 LVR 中如何随推理步骤调节视觉证据注入强度、抑制不可靠视觉旁路的问题存在概念联系，可供核查。
